title: Dynamics of Work Extraction in Multipartite Atomic Systems: Role of Correlations and Relative Entropy
summary: We investigate the dynamics of quantum ergotropy in a multipartite system of two-level atoms interacting with a quantized field. The role of multipartite quantum mutual information and quantum relative entropy is analyzed to understand how correlations and the distinguishability between the passive state and the product of local states affect the extractable work.
